topik: Long Range Communication (LoRa Peer to Peer)
tagline: A LoRa P2P signal hunt between ESP32 boards.
ringkasan: This module uses no external sensor or actuator at all. What is being measured is the radio wave itself: the relationship between signal strength and distance.
Because peer to peer LoRa has no built in channel protocol, every network rule, including the sync word and the transmit interval, is one the participants build themselves.
permainan: Five fully independent Beacon/Hunter pairs, one pair per group, not one shared Beacon everyone races for. An assistant hides one Beacon board per group, its own target. Each group holds one Hunter board that only listens, then reports the signal strength it catches to the scoreboard over Wi-Fi.

The closer a group gets to its OWN target, the stronger the reading. Whichever group finds its own target fastest wins. Distance cannot be compared between groups, since each target is hidden somewhere different.

perangkat.jumlah: 1x per group, as the Beacon its own group hunts

perangkat.nama: Power bank or a long USB cable

pin.judul: RFM95W radio pins on the Cosmic LoRa Aurora V2
catatan: Fit the 920 MHz antenna before the USB cable goes in. Transmitting without an antenna can damage the radio permanently, and that applies to the Beacon board as much as to a Hunter.
GPIO 15, 0, 27, 32, 18, 19 and 23 are already taken by the radio module and must not be used for anything else.
A Hunter needs no voltage divider because nothing is wired to it.
